notes.title: Week 3 Update: Sweet Moments with Niki 🌟
notes.notes:
Dear *Days in Palis* Players!

We are thrilled to announce that the brand-new update is now live! This update focuses on the beloved character Niki, bringing you a heartwarming pure love experience.

Update Highlights:

 1 new night of story content  
A special night exclusively with Niki.  
 70 stunning 2K images added  
 170 new lines of dialogue  
 7 new 2K intimate animations added  


Thank you for your support of *Days in Palis*! Stay tuned, as we will bring you more exciting content. Enjoy the game! 🎉

notes.title: New Update: Week 2 Complete with Turkish Language Support!
notes.notes:
Dear "Days in Palis" Players! 🌟

The content for the second week has been fully updated! This new update includes over 100 2K high-resolution images, 7 voice-acted erotic animations, additional dialogue choices, and mini-games between scenes, allowing you to delve deeper into the world of "Palis" and uncover its secrets.

This update also adds Turkish language support. The game now supports the following languages:
Simplified Chinese 🇨🇳, Traditional Chinese, English, French 🇫🇷, German 🇩🇪, Italian 🇮🇹, Polish 🇵🇱, Spanish, Portuguese, Japanese 🇯🇵, Korean 🇰🇷, Russian 🇷🇺, Turkish 🇹🇷

Thank you for your support of "Days in Palis"!
We will continue to bring you exciting new content and updates. We hope you enjoy the new experience this update provides! Have fun playing! 🎉

notes.title: Week 2 Update: New Story Days and Language Support!
notes.notes:
**Dear *Days in Palis* Players!** 🌟

We are excited to announce that the storyline for Week 2 has been updated! This update not only expands the narrative but also adds support for more languages.

**Update Details: 2 New Story Days** 📖  
In this update, we’ve added two more days of storyline to Week 2! The new content is filled with gripping choices and character interactions, allowing you to delve deeper into the world of *Palis* and uncover its secrets.

**New Language Support** 🌍  
To make this journey accessible to more players, we’ve added support for the following languages:

- German 🇩🇪  
- Italian 🇮🇹  
- Polish 🇵🇱  

**Thank you for your support of *Days in Palis*, and enjoy the game!** 🎉

notes.title: Development Update: Upcoming Content and Roadmap 🚀
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone! 🌟

We’re excited to share our plans for regular updates as we continue to expand the world of Palis. Our team is committed to providing fresh content and improvements, and here’s what you can expect going forward! 🎉

Major Updates (Approximately Every 3 Weeks) 🗓️
Every few weeks, we’ll release a major update packed with exciting new features, including:

New Story Content 📖: Further expansion of the main storyline with new narrative depth and challenges.
New Characters 👤✨: Fresh faces to meet, each bringing unique interactions and depth to the story.
Choice-Based Dialogue 💬: Enhanced dialogue options allowing for more player-driven decisions.
New Animated Scenes 🎞️🔥: Additional animations for intimate scene, to enrich character relationships and storytelling.
Minor Updates 🔧
Between major updates, we’ll roll out smaller patches that focus on:

Multilingual Translations 🌐: Expanding language support to make the game accessible to a wider audience.
Bug Fixes and Optimizations 🐞⚙️: Ensuring a smoother gameplay experience by addressing bugs and refining performance.
As a young studio, we’d like to share that our team members are working part-time on this project while balancing other responsibilities 🕒. This means updates may take a bit longer, but we are dedicated to providing the best experience possible with each release. We appreciate your patience and understanding! 🙏

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 0.0.1
notes.notes:
Hello players!

We’re excited to announce that our game now supports three new languages: French, Japanese, and Russian! 🎉 This update brings the full game experience to even more players around the world, making it easier to dive into the story and enjoy every detail in your native language.

New Languages Added:

French 🇫🇷
Japanese 🇯🇵
Russian 🇷🇺
You can select your preferred language in the Options menu or when the game first start. As always, we appreciate your feedback, so please let us know if you notice any issues or have suggestions to improve the localization!

Thank you for your continued support and enjoy the game!
